rules.neo-prefix: engine custom property gains the --neo- library isolation prefix (ADR 0044 §2.1, I4)
rules.old-skeleton-prefix: legacy theme Global.css token gains --neo- as the fourth temporary kind until steps 8 and 10 retire it (#22295)
rules.motion-role: src/Global.css motion variable takes its step-5 --neo-duration-* or --neo-ease-* role name (ADR 0044 §2.3)
rules.component-stem: abbreviated, unprefixed, or role-shaped engine variable takes its component class stem behind --neo- (ADR 0044 §2.1, §2.4)
rules.bg-to-background: bg feeding the background shorthand becomes background (ADR 0044 §2.4)
rules.text-to-color: text-color and text used for a text colour become color (ADR 0044 §2.4)
rules.state-last: state word moves to the last position from the closed list hover, active, focus, selected, pressed, disabled, invalid, readonly (ADR 0044 §2.4)
rules.css-property-suffix: variable ends with the CSS property that reads it, hyphenated as in CSS (ADR 0044 §2.4)
rules.part-follows-class: part word follows the component DOM class (ADR 0044 §2.4)

--agent-dock-preview-reject.reason: DOM class is .neo-dock-preview; read by border, background-color, and color-mix()

--agent-dock-preview-signal-fill.reason: DOM class is .neo-dock-preview; read by background-color

--agent-dock-preview-signal-ground.reason: DOM class is .neo-dock-preview; holds linear-gradient read by background

--neo-board-card-accent.reason: Holds per-card accent colour read in border-left and progress bar

--neo-board-column-accent.reason: Set by Neo.board.Column#applyColor for column header accent colour

--neo-board-focus-color.reason: Paints focus outline colour on board cards, columns, and lanes

--neo-disabled-opacity.reason: src/Global.css disabled opacity hook; state word disabled moves last

--neo-easing.reason: Set by Neo.grid.plugin.AnimateRows for row transition-timing-function

--neo-transition-time.reason: Set by Neo.component.MagicMoveText for character transition duration
